runtime.execution: Blocking provider/tool loop, thread-backed subagents, native vtable components and channel/session bus.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns sessions, child threads, command processes and configured memory clients; read-only SQLite query consumes workspace DB files.

summary: Actual model SQL query surface, named multi-provider child agents and explicit subset config/skill reload; compaction and durable session history have different content scopes.

inspection.scope: Read turn/tool dispatch, in-turn replay cache, compaction, persistence, process watcher/reap, child spawning/model routing, SQL tool wiring, config/skills reload and audit.
inspection.limits: Source only, no acquired execution. Full channel claim/peer routing, every memory backend and provider request cancellation not exhaustively traced.

actions.name: shell
actions.lifecycle: new noninteractive shell per action; watcher signals then root wait; finite capture

actions.name: sqlite_query
actions.input: workspace DB path, SELECT/WITH/table_info, max rows
actions.lifecycle: opens existing DB read-only; not create/update or namespace service
actions.authority: resolved-path guard, classifier and SQLite readonly backstop

actions.name: spawn / named delegate
actions.output: thread task ID and followup, or one provider completion
actions.lifecycle: spawn async cap/threads vs awaited delegate completion; teardown joins threads
actions.authority: named provider/credential/profile and inherited execution scope

actions.name: message
actions.lifecycle: queued outbound transport; external delivery not confirmed at return

actions.name: config mutation / reload / reloadSkillsAll
actions.input: allowed config path/value or skill changes
actions.lifecycle: explicit supported hot subset; skill invalidation under session locks; some paths restart

actions.name: auto/force compaction
actions.lifecycle: frees prior projection; force can drop without summary

filesystem.detail: Native all-tools set includes workspace operations; code/SQL paths enforce scope. Dedicated file implementation not all studied.

processes.detail: Shell process group and cancellation watcher/root wait; sequential pipe drains and swallowed watcher creation can weaken progress.

code_actions.detail: Shell can execute programs, but no interpreter-based tool orchestration namespace established.

persistent_kernel.detail: Not established beyond inspected turn, process, SQL, subagent, persistence and reload paths.

standing_database.detail: Actual default sqlite_query tool reads standing workspace DBs, plus configured memory tool registration; SQL writes disallowed.

workflow_programming.detail: Native vtables/compiled loop, shell and scheduling primitives; no hot executable whole-turn DSL in inspected paths.

multi_model.detail: Named child agent/provider/model/credentials and explicit runtime model/provider hot change.

live_collaboration.detail: Asynchronous child completion and outbound channel messages; outbound send alone does not establish peer mailbox/busy model delivery.

concurrent_work.detail: Thread-backed subagents capped/reserved under mutex; primary tool calls sequential.

steering_interrupt.detail: Interrupt checked at tool boundaries, shell watcher signals/reaps root; child shutdown joins without active cancellation; provider cancellation not established.

turn_redefinition.detail: Fixed compiled loop and hot config subset, not replacing turn program at a settled workflow boundary.

compaction.detail: Summary/capped input and tail pairing, destructive in-memory replacement; exhaustion force discards middle.

context_repair.detail: Persisted user/final assistant can recover conversation text; intermediate tools/redacted provider data not original repair corpus.

original_audit.detail: Synced rotated security events and optional bounded/redacted diagnostic IO; final user/assistant storage drops intermediate original activity and ignores storage failures.

audit_query.detail: SQL query could inspect local stored tables but full original IO is absent; memory/session scope differs.

hot_change.detail: Explicit model/provider/config subset and lock-protected skills prompt invalidation; restart-required classification.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Persisted final messages/config reload do not serialize child threads or settle provider/program work with outpost handoff.

remote_services.detail: Configured model providers and outbound channel bus consume remote services; external shared kernels not traced.

self_improvement.detail: Not established beyond inspected turn, process, SQL, subagent, persistence and reload paths.

complaints.detail: Not established beyond inspected turn, process, SQL, subagent, persistence and reload paths.

authority.detail: Configured shell validation yields risk block/approval modes and sandbox wrapper, DB strictly read-only; policy breadth not exhaustively traced.

evaluation.detail: Read literal SQL content/readonly and persisted roles/usage, actual command cancellation flag oracle; no descendant-liveness oracle in selected cancel test.

time_order.detail: Command watchdog sums nominal sleep quanta rather than measuring elapsed monotonic time; diagnostics use wall milliseconds.

evidence.claim: Turn refreshes child tool context, local slash handling and optional redaction.
Compiled sequential tool dispatch checks cross-thread interrupt before calls and consults replay cache.
Optional diagnostic args/results bounded1024; tool output scrubbed/redacted and inserted as user reflection text.
Native calls dedup by ID; IDless successful calls by name/raw argument signature without purity or external-state invalidation.
Summary may cover capped source and truncate merged summary; frees prior in-memory messages.
Force context recovery explicitly drops middle without summary, extends keep boundary for tool pairing.
Persist only user/final assistant/runtime commands/usage; storage errors swallowed, reset clears history.
Exact two-message roles/content and usage oracle.
Actual SQLite query/memory/delegate/spawn registrations in all-tools construction.
Workspace scoped read-only SQLite open, statement classifier and engine readonly check; row/byte limits.
Literal count result/table columns and refusal of state-changing PRAGMA.
Actual command authority policy errors include blocked risk and approval required.
Per-action shell process, bounded captures; success discards stderr, failures/timeouts return selected error.
Cancel watcher signals group and Linux descendants, TERM then KILL; timeout counted nominal20ms sleeps.
Separate process group, watcher spawn failure swallowed; sequential stdout then stderr drains and child.wait on normal path.
Real command cancellation thread joined; asserts interrupted/failure flags, not every descendant death.
Mutex/cap reservation then thread spawn with origin/session association and rollback.
Named child provider/model/credential/workspace and inherited authority passed to task runner.
Manager deinit joins child threads; no cancellation branch in this teardown.
Delegate is named provider completion with context, not automatically full tool child loop.
Message tool publishes outbound channel/chat content to bus; sent acknowledgement means queued bus item.
Fixed hot paths mutate model/provider, temperature and iteration/history/time settings.
Actual explicit reload applies supported non-null paths and reports skipped/failed.
Skill prompt reload locks every session before invalidating system prompt.
Allowed config mutation builds and validates candidate before disk apply; restart classification distinct.
Channels/runtime/memory backend/profile/default queue mode classified restart-required.
Security audit schema holds action/outcome metadata, not provider/program original payload.
Optional rotated JSON security events with file.sync, command result selected metadata only.

tests.oracle: Real temporary DB literal count and schema columns, write/PRAGMA restrictions and caps; not run.
Exact two roles/content and usage exposes final-message-only storage; not run.
Real runner returns failure/interrupted after joined command runner; does not inspect all descendants; not run.

strengths: Native Zig runtime with real SQL tool and profile provider/model routing.
Explicitly reports unsupported hot settings and distinguishes restart-required paths.
Session prompt reload locks around active turn state.
limits: Successful IDless tool calls cached by signature without purity; source-inferred stale reads or repeated-side-effect suppression possible.
Normal process path drains stdout/stderr sequentially, watcher spawn failure ignored; progress should be checked directly before reuse.
Final message persistence and security audit omit full original activity.
arconaut_questions: Use exact call identity for replay; do not memoize effects by equal arguments.
Keep SQL query scope visible, including read-only versus writable standing DB.
Make reload scope and confirmed process settlement explicit.
